verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-retention policy, retention window or user-facing deletion control for data Terraform or HCP Terraform holds about the user. The `-destroy` plan, `terraform state` modifications and MCP workspace deletion manage infrastructure and state; they are not privacy-posture retention or deletion controls, so they are adjacent at best. User-side state backups and S3 versioning are workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
